input: Join a community litter-picking group this month

gold.taskTitle: Join a local litter-picking group this month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and join an organised community litter-picking group within the current month.

questions.title: Which town, city, or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the geographic area to search for relevant local groups.

questions.title: Have you already spotted any specific groups online?
questions.description: Determines whether the user has a head start or needs a full search from scratch.

questions.title: Do you prefer a one-off event or regular membership?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user wants a single session or an ongoing commitment.

questions.title: Are there particular days or times you are available?
questions.description: Establishes scheduling constraints to match suitable group meeting times.

questions.title: Is this purely for environmental impact or also social reasons?
questions.description: Understands the motivation so the right type of group can be prioritised.

questions.title: Do you need the group to supply equipment like gloves and bags?
questions.description: Identifies whether equipment provision is a requirement when evaluating groups.

questions.title: What does joining mean to you: attending or actively signing up?
questions.description: Defines what success looks like — simply turning up, or formally registering as a member.
